entities.summary: Assing Leonard Gonzales "Aki" Aleong was a Trinidadian actor and singer. He had a lengthy career as a character actor on television and in film, totaling over 130 credits between 1956 and 2025. He also had a career as a music industry executive during the 1960s and ‘70s.
